label: On-Device Triggers
description: Allows for configuring on-device triggers for recording clips

visionTriggersEnabled.label: Vision Triggers state
visionTriggersEnabled.description: Indicates if Vision Triggers can record clips

supportedTriggers.label: Supported Triggers
supportedTriggers.description: List of Supported Triggers by the device

triggers.label: Triggers
triggers.description: List of enabled Triggers to record clips

soundTriggersEnabled.label: Sound Triggers state
soundTriggersEnabled.description: Indicates if Sound Triggers can record clips

addOrUpdateTriggers.label: Add or Update Triggers
addOrUpdateTriggers.description: Adds or Updates given triggers to the list of enabled Triggers

removeTriggers.label: Remove Triggers
removeTriggers.description: Removes given triggers from the list of enabled Triggers

setVisionTriggersEnabled.label: Set Vision Triggers state
setVisionTriggersEnabled.description: Enable/Disable recording clips from Vision Triggers

setSoundTriggersEnabled.label: Set Sound Triggers state
setSoundTriggersEnabled.description: Enable/Disable recording clips from Sound Triggers
